company.name: Taxdoo
company.shortDescription: Taxdoo provides software that automates sales tax and accounting for e-commerce.
company.description: Taxdoo provides software solutions for automated sales tax compliance and financial accounting in e-commerce. The platform collects and evaluates transaction data from marketplaces and other systems to automatically submit sales tax reports. Taxdoo also offers accounting features with DATEV compatibility and services specifically for tax advisors managing e-commerce mandates.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that automates sales tax calculation, compliance, and bookkeeping for online retailers across multiple marketplaces and systems.
productsAndServices.name: Taxdoo Automated Sales Tax and Accounting Software

productsAndServices.description: A service that handles VAT registration and submission of tax returns across EU countries and the UK for online sellers.
productsAndServices.name: Taxdoo EU and UK VAT Registration and Reporting Service

productsAndServices.description: A curated directory of tax advisors specialized in e-commerce to help online sellers find suitable tax consulting partners.
productsAndServices.name: Taxdoo E-Commerce Tax Advisor Directory

productsAndServices.description: A system that automatically imports and consolidates transaction data from multiple marketplaces, shop systems, payment providers, and ERP systems.
productsAndServices.name: Taxdoo Automated Transaction Data Integration

productsAndServices.description: Software functionality that applies tax rules to transactions for audit-proof VAT calculation and submits tax returns across EU countries.
productsAndServices.name: Taxdoo Automated VAT Assessment and EU-Wide Tax Filing

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $64,602,631, or 75.14% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,066,722 to $350,602,631, a 57.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
